candidates: When reviewing refactored conditional blocks that mutate object properties (e.g., `if (condition) { obj.prop = ...; obj.anotherProp = ...; }`), verify that every assignment statement is properly enclosed within the intended `if` block—check brace placement and indentation carefully, particularly when the refactoring changes nesting depth. A misaligned or missing closing brace can silently cause mutations to execute unconditionally for all iterations, not just the matched case.
